changes: Added authenticated stdlib HTTP bridge to pnl-rag with /health, /v1/stats and /v1/search.
Corrected Mac pilot/bootstrap scripts to use $HOME/.venvs/pnl-video-rag.
Corrected MLX production model identifier to mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo.
Added LUMA server-side PNL RAG adapter and corpus-first tutor path.
Added strict insufficient-evidence and retrieval-unavailable behavior.
Kept local SRT/TXT paths server-side; learner response exposes Drive provenance and timestamps only.
Added PostgreSQL demo backend under isolated luma_pnl schema with pgvector extension and Spanish FTS.
Added transactional SQLite-to-PostgreSQL corpus sync while preserving SQLite as fallback.
LUMA now reports the retrieval backend returned by the bridge instead of hard-coding sqlite-fts5.

findings.finding: Initial SQLite FTS query used OR across all query tokens, allowing false grounding from common words.
findings.evidence: Synthetic E2E query 'zxqv no existe en el corpus' incorrectly returned the only chunk.

findings.finding: Cloud Sandbox runtime is Linux/aarch64 and does not mount the canonical /Users/... Mac paths or the 1,021,031,096-byte production pilot MP4.
The sandbox PNL folder is an untracked mirror under /workspace; it is not an independent Git checkout and the legacy download_subtitles.py is absent there.

changes: Added conversational stopword filtering and minimum meaningful-token overlap to FTS retrieval.
Added regression coverage for natural-language query recall and nonsense-query false positives.
Removed raw retrieval error detail from the learner-facing LUMA response.
Kept PostgreSQL private behind the existing authenticated bridge; LUMA never receives DATABASE_URL.
Kept embedding vector nullable until a real embedding provider is approved; no synthetic semantic vectors are generated.

pnl_rag.postgres_contract: PASS: migration/schema/sync selection covered; real pgvector runtime not available in sandbox
pnl_rag.production_precision: PASS: relevant query grounded; unrelated query returns no hits

synthetic_e2e.insufficient_evidence_response: No encontré evidencia suficiente en el corpus procesado.

release_gate.reason: The real Apple Silicon MLX Large V3 Turbo pilot, ASR spot-check, real SHA/provenance verification and canonical Mac output validation have not executed in this environment.
